intent.proves: The number of attribute categories that carry fields, plus 1 when the largest has more than 25 fields, is at most 1.
intent.scope: Every attribute category except reference_category; global scan.

bindings.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT FieldCategoryId) FROM EcomProductCategoryField WHERE FieldCategoryId <> N'reference_category') + CASE WHEN (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(x.n), 0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM EcomProductCategoryField WHERE FieldCategoryId <> N'reference_category' GROUP BY FieldCategoryId) x) > 25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
